capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: KBB lists 85.00 kWh for the Optiq-V; same pack as the Optiq (Wikipedia: 85.0 kWh usable). Years 2026-2027.

chemistry.notes: Estimated: Wikipedia: Optiq 85 kWh Ultium NMC (GM calls the cells NCMA); same cells across Ultium. Closest enum nmc.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: Wikipedia: Optiq has a 400 V architecture; Equinox EV 85 kWh pack ~290 V modules in the 400 V class (InsideEVs).

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Cadillac DC fast-charging support page (cadillac.com returns 403, read only as a search excerpt by an earlier researcher, not reproduced): routing to a DC fast charger with Google built-in navigation preconditions automatically, plus a manual Fast Charge Prep in the app. Applied to all Ultium Cadillacs, the same as the LYRIQ records. UNVERIFIED on a page for this model.

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: Same 85 kWh pack and charger hardware as the Optiq (150 kW); no Optiq-V-specific figure found.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: The Charge Port does not publish an Optiq-V AC rating ("check the owner's manual"); Optiq standard charger 11.5 kW assumed.
